# Simple. Fast. Addictive. Fun.

More fun than a workout. More sweat than a game.

Now with **multiplayer** — punch it out with friends in BoxBall VR. 

Play **five** boxing-inspired minigames in Mixed Reality and VR. Punch, dodge, and fight for your spot on the leaderboard.

[media]
# PUNCH PADS!
Throw real combos — jabs, crosses, hooks, uppercuts, slips, and ducks. Classic pad work, just like real boxers train.


[media]
#  DUCK OR DIE
Dodge bombs. Smash spheres. Survive as long as you can as the speed keeps climbing.


[media]
#  PUNCH PADS! RHYTHM *(New)*
Hit pads to the beat. Three tracks, three difficulty levels. Nail your timing and chase a perfect score.

[media]
# DUCK STREAM *(New)*
Dodge everything. Train your head movement, slips, and ducks. No punching — pure defensive skill.



#  THE 7‑DAY DUCKERS CHALLENGE
Consistency is everything. Survive for **2 minutes** in any minigame for **7 days straight** to forge the exclusive **Duckers Gloves**. Do you have the iron will to earn them?


# FEATURES:
1. Four minigames
2. Monthly leaderboards & Hall of Fame
3. Mixed Reality — play in your own space
4. Works great on Quest 2, Quest 3, and Quest 3S
5. No complicated setup. No loading screens. Just punch and go.

[media]
#  UPGRADE TO SUPPORTER or PRO STATUS

The game is **free to play** (Punch Pads and Duck Or Die). 

Buy **Supporter Gloves** or **PRO** to unlock Rhythm and Duck Stream — with more exclusive games on the way.

Join our growing community and suggest new minigames:

https://boxing-minigames.com/discord

Write a review if you like the game!
